title: Pulse Bulletin — Spring
summary: Pulse Kickoff, the daily cadence of the Jesus Way, and Pulse Night.

items: Your pace-setter — the daily verse in Library keeps the rhythm on track
Habit of the season — same time, same seat, one verse a day

blocks.text: Pulse walks the same Jesus Way as Surge this season — thirteen weeks, one footstep a day — because a heartbeat is only as steady as the rhythm it keeps. The study habit is the cadence: the guide's daily verse at the same time, like clock. A pulse that marches daily becomes a pulse that leads. March steady, live loud.
Walk by the Spirit, and you will not gratify the desires of the flesh.
